name: unify-parameter-validation-policy
title: Unify the parameter validation policy
description: 1.0 gate 6 of 9. Audit P2-3: direct EQ, saturation, volume, FIR EQ, and limiter setters do not share the facade validation policy, LoudnessMeter can suppress initialization failure and still report a reliable measurement, and set_ref_volume_db can overwrite a concurrent partial update. One shared validated policy with private unchecked kernels.
